next_action.description: Start MPI-536 (LTX 2.3 foley). Its ONLY prereq is the foley LoRA: check whether ltx-2.3-22b-lora-foley-v2a-1.0.safetensors has a public HF mirror (the sibling ltx23-lora-talkvid dep mirrors Comfy-Org/ltx-2.3), then stage it to R2 and add a dependencies.js entry. After that the Flow itself is a copy of the ltx-extend shape - read docs/playbooks/add-flow/existing-flows/ltx-extend.md rather than re-deriving it. MPI-536 also OWNS the foley-vs-voice mode decision; voice mode has never been run, and shipping foley alone in v1 is a legitimate answer.

key_decisions: MPI-531 item 1 as carded was NOT sufficient - fields render on middle steps only, so FlowDef.controls shipped with it. A new Flow declares controls and ships NO uiComponent; if a control is not expressible, add the field type.
The trio's order changed: extend went FIRST, not foley. Extend needs no new weight; foley and lipsync each need a LoRA that is not a dep yet. Recorded in MPI-552/plan.md Plan Drift.
ltx-extend requires ltx-23-balanced specifically - the proven graph bakes the int8 transformer. One tier, one workflow file, acceptable because the Flow Library is dev-gated.

ltx-extend exposes NO resolution control: ImageResizeKJv2 takes width/height from Input_Video's own outputs, so the output matches the source. This is the OPPOSITE of foley, where those inputs were deleted because they fed only the encode. Do not carry either decision across.
The raw graph was renamed to flow_ltx_extend.json - a bare name converts straight to a runtime file; the _template suffix routes to a generator that does not exist for flows.
constraints: MPI-557 is a PEER SESSION's card and is NOT a Flow - it is a video-face-detailer experiment. It was parked to todo by mistake this session and restored to doing. Do not touch it, its files, or its column.

The user is running RunPod video work, so the GPU is theirs. Do not dispatch a generation. The payload of a Flow can be proven with no run: strip state.s_installedModelIds in your OWN app instance, click Generate, and read state.s_flowInputs - _run persists BEFORE submitFlowGeneration's availability guard aborts.

Never drive :3000 - that is the user's live app. Spin your own with `CUBRIC_MODELS_ROOT="G:/CubricModels" npm run app:isolated` and never pipe the launch into tail/head (the output buffers and the READY line never arrives). TaskStop leaves the Electron alive holding the profile lock, so the next launch dies silently at ~2.3s - kill the process TREE.
Convert workflows against the APP engine on 48188, never the 8188 bench, and never run workflow-to-api.mjs bare (it converts all of raw/).
